ResourceHeader.ResourceName: Mars Science Laboratory (MSL), Radiation Assessment Detector (RAD), Level 1 Observational Counter Data

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial release of metadata, ADAPT generated, LFB
Curated and checked for SPASE 2.7.2 structural and semantic consistency, OK

ResourceHeader.Description: The Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Radiation Assessment Detector (RAD) Level 1 observational counter data product contains time-tagged instrument housekeeping and observation metadata; rover and solar geometry; quality-filtered and all-quality linear energy transfer (LET) histograms for the A1 and A2 silicon detectors with associated LET bin energies; fast and slow hardware trigger counts for RAD detector channels; and hardware event match and read counters. The RAD instrument is described in detail by Hassler et al. (2012).
ResourceHeader.Acknowledgement: Please acknowledge the RAD Principal Investigator Dr. Hassler of Southwest Research Institute Boulder. The RAD data are archived as fully citable data. Please consult the RAD team for further details on processing and usage of these data.
